entries.what: Late morning at the Verdant Commons kitchen table, Noemi asks for help writing a short email to Rhonda that 'mentions' she's covering Greg's duties without asking for anything.
entries.outcome: Sends a softened email that mentions the coverage and asks for nothing.

entries.what: Before shift she moves her network cert exam from Nov 8 to Saturday Dec 6 because the overtime leaves no study time.
entries.outcome: Exam now Dec 6; she keeps drilling a little each day.

entries.what: On the 1 p.m. to 11:30 p.m. swing at RF-4, Rhonda replies in the IT cage that the permanent lead decision comes after peak, mid-December.
entries.outcome: Noemi knows the wait runs to December and keeps doing Greg's work.

entries.what: Late night at home, Iris is still up and Noemi tells her about the timeline over reheated rice.
entries.outcome: Iris says to just apply; Noemi goes to bed around 1 a.m.

entries.what: Slow morning at home, Noemi calls this 'hardcore mode' week and asks for a meal-prep list for the 10-hour swings.
entries.outcome: Gets a short list of rice bowls and snacks; Iris adds it to the budget sheet.

entries.what: At RF-4 she spends the afternoon in the cage on dead scanners, with the ~30-handheld pile at peak.
entries.outcome: Bao handles several battery swaps; the cage shrinks a bit.

entries.what: Carla texts Noemi's cell about a dead scanner on the outbound dock mid-shift.
entries.outcome: Swapped on the dock in ten minutes.

entries.what: Noemi sleeps in until nine, then does a block of subnetting flashcards with coffee before shift.
entries.outcome: Finishes one chapter of the study guide.

entries.what: She stops by Ana's office at RF-4 and learns Ana handles the internal lead posting paperwork.
entries.outcome: Gets the posting details and says she'll think about it.

entries.what: Evening swing: a run of frozen handhelds on the floor keeps her moving.
entries.outcome: Clears the queue by close.

entries.what: Wakes late and updates her RMA sheet at home, listing scanners to send back to the vendor.
entries.outcome: Sheet current for the week.

entries.what: Afternoon training with Bao in the cage on trigger-board swaps.
entries.outcome: Bao completes one swap alone.

entries.what: Iris orders Thursday sushi and Noemi eats it at midnight after work.
entries.outcome: Quiet end to the day.

entries.what: Fills up at the Ruel Road station and has Taquería Colima tacos for the Friday meal at her desk.
entries.outcome: Eats between tickets.

entries.what: She submits her application for the permanent IT desk lead through Ana's posting process.
entries.outcome: Application submitted and confirmed.

entries.what: Evening on the floor, Victor's acting-lead mess slows her down on a vendor ticket; she works late.
entries.outcome: Fixes it herself.

entries.what: Saturday morning walk on the Ulloa marsh boardwalk before her overtime Saturday.
entries.outcome: Clears her head.

entries.what: Works the every-other-Saturday overtime shift at RF-4, mostly scanner triage.
entries.outcome: Carla's crew gets through with few red beeps.

entries.what: Home late, she and Iris watch a show on their shared streaming account.
entries.outcome: Asleep by one.

entries.what: Sunday late morning she runs subnetting drills and asks for harder problems.
entries.outcome: Does a drill set and plans more before the next swing.

entries.what: Visits her parents' fourplex off Vinca Avenue and fixes the printer.
entries.outcome: Printer works again.

entries.what: Sunday night she plays her co-op survival game as packetloss_ with her squad.
entries.outcome: Finishes a run and logs off.
